plan.name: Run recording heap stress tests in integration CI
plan.summary: Move the large-recording entry points TestGateRecordingPeakHeap, TestGateRefusedRecordingPeakHeap and TestPythonApplicationConversionPeakHeap into internal/verify/recording_heap_integration_test.go with the existing integration build tag, preserving their names so each appears exactly once in the tagged inventory and never in the ordinary inventory and therefore runs in the existing CI integration lane. Extract both errors and validation and interleaved sampled lifecycles, with every original assertion, into the ordinary TestPythonApplicationConversionValidation; retain shared fixtures as needed and all ordinary gate ownership, byte compatibility, cancellation, cleanup, refusal, Python application transport and recording-storage regression coverage. Preserve all 32,768- and 65,536-entry workloads, Go and TypeScript routes, successful and late-bad cases, refused attempts, sampled and explored Python conversion, the 192 MiB gate and 96 MiB additional conversion ceilings, descriptor bounds, cleanup, full recording and tail inspection, coverage counts, GOMAXPROCS=1, GOGC=100, GOMEMLIMIT=off, TLCParallel=1, sampling and baseline accounting, and the existing child selectors and timeouts so child processes still execute the measured tests, without changing the streaming implementation. Add acceptance coverage for real ordinary and integration inventories and execution of the retained functional cases, run go test -tags=integration ./internal/verify -run '^(TestGateRecordingPeakHeap|TestGateRefusedRecordingPeakHeap|TestPythonApplicationConversionPeakHeap)$' -count=1 -timeout 20m plus ordinary package checks and shuffled repeated and race runs of the affected ordinary tests, and retain the existing CI lane, four-CPU default quota, eight sandbox workers, 4 GiB and 1,024-process limits, check queue and ordinary and verify deadlines without changes under .github/ or a new environment opt-in. Update SPEC.md with existing decision citations and docs/factory.md with the ordinary-versus-integration coverage and explicit stress command, following D-0105, D-0122 and D-0294 and preserving D-0281, D-0313 and D-0350; the merger must record the new test scheduling decision refining D-0333, since the plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestRecordingHeapStressIntegrationInventory684
tests.says: The real ordinary test inventory excludes all three recording heap stress names; the integration inventory registers each exactly once, and the tagged-minus-ordinary selection includes all three while keeping functional recording tests ordinary.

tests.name: TestRecordingFunctionalDefaultCoverage684
tests.says: The default test binary actually runs and passes both extracted conversion validation groups, every gate ownership and compatibility case, sampled and explored application transport including strict refusal failure, and the existing recording-storage regressions, with no skipped or duplicated cases.
